title: Perimeter intelligence for tank farms and depots

scenes.headline: A fence marks the boundary. It does not watch it.
scenes.voice: Around a tank farm or a depot, the fence marks the boundary. But on its own, a fence does not watch anything.

scenes.headline: Perimeter intelligence, layer by layer.
scenes.voice: FOG Technologies Nexus adds the intelligence. Thermal and infrared cameras see through darkness and haze. Line-crossing analytics flag movement at the fence, and perimeter lighting supports clear images.

scenes.headline: Detected. Verified. Escalated.
scenes.voice: When something crosses the line, the alarm goes straight to a control room, where an operator verifies it on camera and escalates it to the people who respond.

scenes.headline: Request an executive briefing
scenes.voice: Request an executive briefing about perimeter security for your sites. Write to CEO at fogtechnexus.space.
